summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K announcing routine share buybacks during June 8-12, 2026, repurchasing 2.7 million Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 114.40 per share (total SEK 308.9 million). The buybacks are part of a pre-announced program of up to SEK 15 billion running from April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The Board intends to propose cancelling repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. This is a standard capital return activity, not a special situation.
